title: The Circleville Letter Writer
description: Beginning in the 1970s, residents of Circleville, Ohio, received anonymous threatening letters exposing personal details. The identity and full scope of the letter-writing campaign remain debated.

scenes.narration: In the 1970s, residents of Circleville, Ohio, began receiving disturbing anonymous letters.

scenes.narration: The letters contained personal information and accusations that seemed to come from someone who knew the town well.

scenes.narration: Some messages escalated into threats, turning a quiet community against itself.

scenes.narration: A local school-bus driver became central to the investigation after a dangerous roadside sign incident.
